definitions.explanation: An abnormal rise in sea level caused by a typhoon or low-pressure system pushing seawater toward the coast. A dangerous weather phenomenon that can cause flooding in coastal areas.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧{高潮|たかしお}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{警戒|けいかい}して→警戒する：25375_keikaisuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please be on alert for storm surges caused by the typhoon.

examples.japanese: {高潮|たかしお}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{海岸|かいがん}→海岸：00852_kaigan⟧{沿|ぞ}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{道路|どうろ}→道路：01481_douro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{冠水|かんすい}→冠水：20916_kansui⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The coastal road was flooded by the storm surge.

examples.japanese: {高潮|たかしお}⟦{警報|けいほう}→警報：09515_keihou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発令|はつれい}→発令：09516_hatsurei⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{沿岸|えんがん}→沿岸：13280_engan⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{住民|じゅうみん}→住民：03281_juumin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{避難|ひなん}{指示|しじ}→避難指示：20801_hinanshiji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: A storm surge warning was issued, and an evacuation order was given to residents in coastal areas.

notes:
USAGE:
{高潮|たかしお} is a key weather and disaster term in Japan. It refers specifically to the dangerous rise in sea level caused by typhoons and storms, not regular tidal changes. It frequently appears in weather reports during typhoon season.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {高潮|たかしお}⟦{警報|けいほう}→警報：09515_keihou⟧ (storm surge warning)
- {高潮|たかしお}⟦{注意報|ちゅういほう}→注意報：16464_chuuihou⟧ (storm surge advisory)
- {高潮|たかしお}⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧ (storm surge damage)
- {高潮|たかしお}⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧ (storm surge countermeasures)

NOTE ON READING:
The reading たかしお is used for the storm surge meaning. The same kanji can also be read こうちょう, meaning "climax" or "high point" (e.g., ⟦{最高潮|さいこうちょう}→最高潮：19278_saikouchou⟧ — the peak/climax).
